# SYNTH-v2 audit pack

For the independent reviewers (review round 2). Method: [../README.md](../README.md).
**All counts and distributions are in [STATS.md](STATS.md)**, generated by
`sepalith.data.synth.report` from `build-summary.json`, the manifest and the
TRAIN/v1/v2 profile; this file holds no hand-typed counts beyond those quoted
in the findings table (copied from STATS.md / receipts at commit time).

## What to review

| Item | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Generated statistics (counts by family/cut type/determinacy/behaviour, distributions vs TRAIN and v1, shaping, decontamination, probe) | [STATS.md](STATS.md) |
| Stratified sample of 60 v2 cases (seed 20261022; diff, target, verification, rendered prompt), bound to the manifest hash in its header | [audit-sample-60.md](audit-sample-60.md), ids [audit-sample-60-ids.json](audit-sample-60-ids.json) |
| Manifest / build summary / self-check | `../../receipts/SYNTH-v2-manifest.json`, `SYNTH-v2-build-summary.json`, `SYNTH-v2-selfcheck.json` |
| Arm A probe on 150 fresh v2 cases (audit ids excluded) | `../../receipts/SYNTH-v2-arm-a-probe.json` |
| Cohort proposal (14+2 default, 13+3 comparison) | `../../receipts/SYNTH-v2-cohort-proposal.json` |
| Census whitespace analysis (sources the v1 "434 of 477" figure) | `../../receipts/SYNTH-census-whitespace.json`, `../census_whitespace.py` |
| Seeds v2, revision brief, behavioural checks | [../seeds-v2/](../seeds-v2/), [../REVISION-BRIEF-v2.md](../REVISION-BRIEF-v2.md), `../seeds-v2/<batch>/checks/` |
| v1 (kept for comparison) | `/mnt/e/.../SYNTH-v1/`, `../seeds/`, `../../receipts/SYNTH-v1-*` |

## Generator scripts

| Script | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/sepalith/src/sepalith/data/synth/r_structure.R`, `structure.py` | Parse structure (getParseData; never evaluates) |
| `.../synth/normalize.py` | Authored blank lines kept; `air format`; idempotence check |
| `.../synth/cases.py` | Case model, PRM03 context, history events |
| `.../synth/common.py` | Lexing, novelty (identifiers, string words, numbers), structural support |
| `.../synth/finish_block.py` | Cuts, TRAIN headers, packaging, determinacy classes |
| `.../synth/roxygen.py` | Signature checks, determined share, trivial-block filter |
| `.../synth/verify.py`, `r_parse_status.R` | Mechanical verification |
| `.../synth/r_behaviour.R` | Behavioural checks (base R) |
| `.../synth/dedup.py`, `cpt_check.py` | Token fingerprints, masked structure, line 4-grams, MinHash; bound CPT hits |
| `.../synth/build.py` | End-to-end build, guards, shaping, ledgers, manifest |
| `.../synth/profile.py`, `report.py` | TRAIN/SYNTH distribution profile; STATS.md |
| `.../synth/cohort.py`, `../make_cohort.py` | Direct no-op exposure assertion; cohort, schedules, length profile |
| `.../synth/selfcheck.py`, `audit.py`, `../probe_arm_a.py` | Self-check, this sample, arm A probe |
| Tests | `packages/sepalith/tests/test_synth.py` (core), `packages/sepalith/tests/training/test_synth_v2.py` (dedup, verify, guard_path, no-op cap, novelty) |

## Known limitations

1. **Volume vs determinacy.** Only demonstrably constrained cuts are kept;
   context-determined medium and long completions are scarce, so the
   cohort-level length rule binds and v2 is far smaller than v1. Long
   buckets (21-45 lines) remain heavily under-represented in SYNTH alone;
   the TRAIN + SYNTH cohort stays within 3 points of TRAIN per bucket.
   Relaxing the SYNTH-alone 2x ratio cap roughly doubles volume (see
   PR text); that is a mixing decision, not a quality change.
2. **Determinacy is a proxy.** `constrained_short` bounds what is new
   lexically, not every structural choice; `sibling` relies on masked
   8-gram support from the prompt. The arm A probe shows how hard the cases
   are.
3. **Blank lines and comments.** Within short buckets the (blank, comment)
   mix matches TRAIN; within the medium buckets SYNTH has more blank lines and
   fewer comments than TRAIN because every qualified medium case is used.
4. **Behavioural coverage is partial.** Code needing add-on packages
   (dplyr, data.table, shiny, R6, ...) is parse-checked only; per-case
   evidence is in `meta.behaviour`.
5. **Roxygen prose is still free text.** Roxygen is kept small (<= 10%);
   tag frequencies are matched where the available blocks allow.
6. **Residual contamination risk:** LLM-memorised paraphrase cannot be
   detected by any of the filters (see ../README.md).
7. **One author family / one brief.** A residual house style remains.
